about:
Razorback Equipment Company operates from Howell, Michigan, where it designs and builds slicing machinery for industrial meat packing plants. The company’s founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures a range of slicing systems, including fully automated, semi-automatic, and manual slicers, as well as complementary equipment such as interleavers, slice-and-weigh jump conveyors, and meat stackers. Its product lineup includes the Model C, Model R, and a dedicated pepperoni slicer, all engineered for precision portioning of various meat products.

Razorback serves industrial meat packing plants and food processing facilities that require high-throughput portioning equipment. Customers include operations processing everything from tender cuts to robust portions, with the equipment designed to meet rigorous food safety and hygiene standards.

The company states that safety, hygiene, and ease of maintenance are central to its equipment design, aiming to minimize downtime and support compliance with industry regulations. Its machines are marketed as delivering consistent slice accuracy across a wide range of product types and production volumes.
